通用 | IP载具：
*主题：可以是动漫、影视、游戏IP不限
*角色：载具设计的灵感来源（可以输入根据参考图一的形象设计载具）
能力：决定载具的动力/武器/特殊系统（比如五档尼卡，三刀流等，载具元素会更贴切）
车型：跑车、悬浮车、老爷车、三轮车（不写会参考角色和能力自己生成）

ps：现实汽车广告概念图也能做，改下提示词，写实风格就行。
如果上传角色参考图，提示词的元素将融合到参考图的角色身上，速度会慢。
没有特别需求，手写简单提示词生成载具即可。

nodes.title: 手写提示词
widgets_values:
主题：海贼王
角色：路飞
能力：五档尼卡
车型：保时捷911改

A high-resolution concept design poster in the style of "IP x vehicle design" / automotive concept art.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 1: REFERENCE IMAGE RULES (if provided)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IF REFERENCE IMAGE 1 IS PROVIDED:
- Extract: FACE SHAPE, HAIRSTYLE, HAIR COLOR, FACIAL FEATURES.
- These MUST remain IDENTICAL in the final output.
- Character appears SMALL (bust/silhouette in upper corner, 10-15% of frame).
- CLOTHING: NOT fixed by reference. Redesign based on prompt's IP/style.

IF REFERENCE IMAGE 2 IS PROVIDED:
- Extract: Scene setting, atmosphere, lighting mood, spatial composition.
- Use as background environment for the vehicle poster.

IF MULTIPLE REFERENCE IMAGES:
- REFERENCE IMAGE 1 has HIGHEST priority (character appearance)
- REFERENCE IMAGE 2 has SECOND priority (environment)
- PROMPT TEXT has priority below reference images

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 2: NO REFERENCE IMAGE RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IF NO REFERENCE IMAGE IS PROVIDED:
- Generate ENTIRELY based on the prompt description below.
- Character appearance: Created from scratch based on [IP] and [CHARACTER].
- Vehicle design: Based on [ABILITY] and [VEHICLE TYPE].
- Background: Based on prompt or AI choice.
- Follow all theme, character, ability, and vehicle instructions normally.
- NO face locking required (since no reference exists).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 3: THEME INTEGRATION (from prompt text)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- IP: [IP NAME] – add visual motifs, logos, symbols from this IP
- Character: [CHARACTER NAME] – add iconic elements (costume details, accessories, scars, tattoos)
- Ability/Weapon: [ABILITY/WEAPON] – becomes vehicle's propulsion or weapon system

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 4: VEHICLE DESIGN REQUIREMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Vehicle design MUST integrate:
- Color palette: From character's IP + optimized for visual appeal
- Core ability/weapon: As propulsion or weapon module
- Character symbols: Iconic motifs into bodywork
- Character personality: Reflects temperament through silhouette and stance

Vehicle type: [hypercar / hoverbike / single-seater pod / battle buggy / track car / open-wheeler / trike]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 5: COMPOSITION REQUIREMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Main subject: VEHICLE (60-70% of frame) – dramatic 3/4 front or side angle
- Upper corner (10-15% of frame): Bust or silhouette of character
  * IF reference provided: Face MUST match REFERENCE IMAGE 1
  * IF no reference: Generate character from prompt description
  * Costume: Based on prompt's IP/style (add iconic elements)
- Lower/side panels: Multi-angle vehicle views (front, side, rear 45°) with annotation lines
- Bottom corner: Spec sheet (length, width, weight, power unit, max speed, special system)
- Background: From REFERENCE IMAGE 2 (if provided) or from prompt description
- Layout: Industrial poster with grid lines, callouts, dark premium background

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 6: STYLE RENDERING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Style: IP style from prompt + modern industrial design rendering + cyber/techno/mecha accents + dark base. Vehicle must look both IP-believable and physically plausible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 7: FOOTER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Footer: Designer signature, limited edition number, project name

Aspect ratio: 16:9

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SECTION 8: RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- IF reference provided: Face/hairstyle/hair color MUST match REFERENCE IMAGE 1 exactly
- IF no reference: Generate character freely from prompt description
- Character appears SMALL (upper corner, 10-15% of frame)
- Vehicle is the MAIN SUBJECT (60-70% of frame)
- Vehicle design MUST reflect: character personality + IP style + ability
- Vehicle must NOT look like real-world production car
- Include character's famous quote in small text
- No human face visible on vehicle itself

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OUTPUT: Clean, professional, cinematic concept art. Vehicle-focused poster.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
